svg.title: Native-cell Drake volume and heat contribution maps
svg.desc: Matched latitude-depth sections show signed four-sample mean volume and zero-degree-reference heat contributions for every wet native face cell, using nonlinear depth and asinh color scales.

svg.text: Per-cell intensity is resolution-dependent; the accounting meaning comes from signed sums, not from treating bright cells as permanent geographic objects.
NONLINEAR DEPTH + ASINH COLOR SCALES · FOUR MONTHS, NOT CLIMATOLOGY · HEAT SIGN DEPENDS ON TREF 0°C · NOT CONVERGENCE OR ANTARCTIC DELIVERY
svg.metadata: Arithmetic mean of February, May, August, and November 2018 native-section cells. The nonlinear display depth scale and sampled velocity marks are visual encodings, not transport integration, water-mass boundaries, an annual mean, or a climatology.
